subject: linalg
title: Linear algebra
description: From vectors to the spectral theorem, in the order most first courses take it.

concepts.title: Vectors and linear combinations
concepts.summary: Adding and scaling vectors; every vector as a combination of others.

concepts.title: Span and linear independence
concepts.summary: What a set of vectors can reach, and when none of them is redundant.

concepts.title: Matrices and matrix multiplication
concepts.summary: Rectangular arrays of numbers and the product that composes them.

concepts.title: Linear maps
concepts.summary: Functions that preserve addition and scaling; a matrix is one written in coordinates.

concepts.title: Gaussian elimination
concepts.summary: Row operations that solve Ax = b and reveal pivots.

concepts.title: Inverse matrices
concepts.summary: When a map can be undone, and how to compute the undoing.

concepts.title: Basis and dimension
concepts.summary: A minimal spanning set, and the count that every such set shares.

concepts.title: Null space and column space
concepts.summary: What a map sends to zero, and what it can reach.

concepts.title: Rank–nullity theorem
concepts.summary: Dimension of the domain equals rank plus nullity.

concepts.title: Change of basis
concepts.summary: The same map described in different coordinates: A and P⁻¹AP.

concepts.title: Determinants
concepts.summary: The signed volume scaling of a map; zero exactly when it is not invertible.

concepts.title: Characteristic polynomial
concepts.summary: det(A − λI), whose roots are the eigenvalues.

concepts.title: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
concepts.summary: Directions a map only stretches, and by how much.

concepts.title: Diagonalization
concepts.summary: Writing a map as a pure stretch in a basis of eigenvectors.

concepts.title: Inner products and orthogonality
concepts.summary: Length, angle and perpendicularity, generalised beyond the dot product.

concepts.title: Orthonormal bases and Gram–Schmidt
concepts.summary: Turning any basis into a perpendicular unit-length one.

concepts.title: Projections and least squares
concepts.summary: The closest point in a subspace, and the best-fit solution to Ax = b.

concepts.title: Spectral theorem
concepts.summary: Symmetric matrices diagonalise in an orthonormal basis with real eigenvalues.

concepts.title: Singular value decomposition
concepts.summary: Every matrix as rotate, stretch, rotate.

concepts.title: Markov chains
concepts.summary: Repeated application of a stochastic matrix and its steady state.
